queries: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), compared AS (SELECT *, AVG(site_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_ratio FROM site_ratios) SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS above_average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(site_ratio - status_ratio) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE site_ratio > status_ratio GROUP BY insurstat

WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), compared AS (SELECT *, AVG(site_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_ratio FROM site_ratios) SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS above_average_ratio, SUM(mesh_count) AS mesh_count, AVG(site_ratio - status_ratio) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE site_ratio > status_ratio GROUP BY insurstat

WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sr.insurstat, AVG(sr.avg_ratio) AS above_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_avg_site_count, SUM(sr.mesh_count) AS above_avg_mesh_count, AVG(sr.avg_ratio - sa.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM site_ratios AS sr JOIN status_averages AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat WHERE sr.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY sr.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: The final count means the number of above-average sites. A zero geometric accuracy makes the ratio undefined and is ignored.

alternatives.interpretation: The final count means the total mesh records belonging to above-average sites.
